transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

Um... well, I ended up calling the employee assistance program at work. It's... mostly just that I'm barely sleeping right lately. 

I just lie there, replaying work stuff, or... you know, arguments at home. And then I usually wake up around 3 or 4 in the morning anyway. By the time I actually have to start the day, I just feel like I never really rested. So... yeah. That's why I'm here.
Have you been feeling down, hopeless, or losing interest in things you usually enjoy, especially around the same time your sleep problems started?

Yeah, I guess you could say that. It's... mostly just this heavy feeling. Like a gray mood that just kind of follows me around. From the office, to the car, to the house. Even when nothing in particular is going on, I just feel... I don't know, kind of hollow, I suppose.
How long have you been feeling this way? Has it been at least two weeks, or is it more like just the last few days or a week?

It's... definitely been longer than two weeks. I'd say... maybe a year and two months? Give or take. That's... I guess that's around the time the arguments at home started getting a lot worse. So... yeah. A while.
Have you felt a lack of energy or noticed that even small tasks feel really tiring lately?
Um... no, not really. I mean, I'm tired from not sleeping, obviously. But... I don't think it's like what you're saying. I still do what I need to do.
Have you found yourself feeling guilty about things, even when you know it's not really your fault, or feeling like you're a bad person?

Yeah, I guess so. I mean... I just think about things a lot. Like, staying late at the office, or... I don't know, spending money on stupid stuff, going to tailgates instead of being home. It just... I don't know. I just end up feeling like my wife and kids got stuck with someone who's just... selfish, I guess. Like I just keep letting them down.
Have you noticed that you're moving more slowly than usual, or that you can't sit still and feel restless?

I don't know about restless. But... yeah, maybe a little slower. I don't think my team at work has noticed anything major, but... I can tell. I just... I'll sit there staring at my laptop for a while before I actually do anything. And sometimes one of the reps will ask me a simple question, and it just takes me a second too long to process it and answer. But it's not... it's not like I'm falling apart or anything. Just a bit sluggish, I guess.
Have you found that you don't care about things as much as you used to, or that activities you once enjoyed, like hobbies or time with family, don't bring you the same pleasure?

Yeah, I guess. Um... I used to do a lot of stuff. Pickup basketball, bowling nights... going to music festivals. I used to really like firing up the smoker when friends came over. 

But lately... I don't know. I just... I end up canceling a lot. Or if I do go, I'm just kind of... there. Just going through the motions, I guess. It just doesn't feel the same.
Have you ever felt like life isn’t worth living, or had thoughts about ending your life?

Um... no. I mean, I'm not... I'm not making a plan to hurt myself or anything like that. 

It's just... I don't know. Sometimes the thought comes up. More than I want to admit, I guess. Just... thinking that maybe everyone would be better off if I just didn't wake up one morning. But I wouldn't actually do anything.
Have you noticed any changes in your appetite or weight lately—like not wanting to eat, or losing weight without trying?

Um... I guess my appetite has been a little off. For a few months now, really. 

I don't know, I just... I kind of run on coffee all morning, skip lunch. And then at dinner with my wife and kids, I just sort of pick at my food. I'm just not that hungry. But... I don't know about losing weight. If anything, I've noticed my belt is actually a notch tighter than it used to be.
Have you noticed that your movements or speech have slowed down, or that you're not as quick to respond or react as you used to be?

Um... I guess so. I mean, nobody at work has said anything, so I don't think I'm, like, falling apart or anything. 

But... yeah. I guess I've noticed I'm moving a bit slower. Sometimes I just sit there staring at my laptop for a while. And... if one of my sales reps asks me a simple question, it just takes me a second longer to answer them. I just... I don't know, take a beat too long, I guess.
Do you find yourself worrying excessively about things, even when you know there's not much you can do about them, or feeling like your mind is constantly racing with anxious thoughts?
Um... no. Not really. I mean, there's the usual stress with the job, but... no. My mind doesn't really race or anything like that. I wouldn't say I'm worrying all the time.
Have you noticed that your movements or speech have slowed down significantly, to the point where other people might notice it?
I mean... like I said earlier, nobody has said anything to me about it. So... no, I don't think so. It's not significant like that. Just me noticing it.
Do you find yourself feeling overly anxious or worried about things like work performance, family issues, or other responsibilities, even when there isn’t an immediate problem?
No, not really. Like I said... it's just normal work stuff. I'm not overly anxious about it.
Have you experienced a loss of interest or pleasure in activities to the point where you no longer look forward to anything at all, even things you used to really enjoy?

Yeah, I guess. Um... I used to do a lot of stuff. Pickup basketball, bowling nights... going to music festivals, or just firing up the smoker for friends. Stuff like that. 

But lately... I don't know. I either just cancel, or if I do show up, I feel like I'm just going through the motions. I just don't really look forward to it right now.
Have you reached a point where you’ve completely lost interest in things you used to really enjoy, like hobbies, time with friends, or even time with your family?
I think... I mean, I kind of just answered that. Like I said, the basketball, the bowling, the smoker... I just don't care about it right now. I just go through the motions if I even go at all.
Have you completely lost interest in all activities you used to enjoy, including things that were once very important to you?
Yeah. I mean... like I just said. Yes. The music festivals, bowling... all that stuff I just mentioned. I either cancel or just go through the motions. I don't really know what else to tell you.
